customManagers.description: ARG BAIKAL_VERSION. The dockerfile manager only reads an ARG that a FROM expands, and this one feeds a release URL.

packageRules.description: jq tags releases as jq-1.8.2. mise strips that prefix from aqua's registry entry; Renovate does not read the aqua registry, so without this every candidate version is discarded as unparseable and no PR is ever raised.

prBodyNotes: `ARG BAIKAL_SHA256` still holds the previous archive's checksum and is not updated by this PR. The build's `sha256sum -c` fails until it is set by hand:

`baikal.openvex.json` argues three grpc advisories unreachable, scoped to `pkg:golang/google.golang.org/grpc@v1.81.1`. A builder that ships a different grpc makes those statements stop matching and `just scan` goes red. Re-argue reachability against the version this build ships and update the statements, or delete them — widening the version to clear the finding asserts something nobody checked.

The acceptance suite asserts the binary carries no file capability. Upstream's own FrankenPHP builds set `cap_net_bind_service=ep`, and a binary with a file capability cannot be exec'd at all under `--cap-drop ALL`.
